description: A Next.js App Router app that sends welcome, password reset, and Stripe receipt emails with Courier, delivered through Resend.
rules: Use @trycourier/courier and read COURIER_API_KEY from the environment. Never hard-code a key.
Import the Courier client only from lib/courier.ts, which imports server-only, so the key never reaches a client bundle.
Send from server actions and route handlers with client.send.message, and set routing to the channels you want.
Pass an Idempotency-Key per event: a reset id for password resets, the Stripe event.id for receipts.
Verify Stripe webhooks with Stripe.webhooks.constructEvent on the raw body from request.text().
